description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing orders in a food delivery application, including placing orders, listing user orders, retrieving order details, and cancelling orders. It interfaces with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models, handles business logic for order creation, and enforces role-based access control.

classes.name: OrderResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for serializing Order data in responses

classes.name: APIMessage
classes.description: Pydantic model for simple API response messages

classes.name: PlaceOrderRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for incoming place order requests

classes.name: Order
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing an order

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing an item within an order

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Model for tracking status changes over time for an order

methods.name: OrderResponse _order_to_schema(order: Order)
methods.description: Converts an Order ORM instance to an OrderResponse schema

methods.name: OrderResponse place_order( payload: PlaceOrderRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: Endpoint to place a new order from the current cart

methods.name: List[OrderResponse] list_my_orders( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all orders for the logged-in customer

methods.name: OrderResponse get_my_order( order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve details of a specific order for the customer

methods.name: APIMessage cancel_order( order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user=Depends(require_role(UserRole.CUSTOMER)), )
methods.description: Endpoint to cancel a customer's order if eligible
